Website information

Sources and credits.

Restaurant information

Phone number, opening hours, rating and review count checked against the Google Maps listing on 5 November 2026. Opening hours may vary on public holidays.

Menu

Dishes and prices transcribed from public photographs of the menu. Some photographs predate this consultation. The current menu, prices and ingredients must be confirmed with the restaurant. No allergens have been inferred.

Images

The images were created using artificial intelligence based on photographs of the business and dishes described on its menu. Categories without a direct reference photograph use a visual interpretation of their ingredients. These are illustrative images, not documentary photographs; actual presentation may vary.

Reviews

We display 143 excerpts from five-star reviews with their authors, consulted directly on Google Maps on 6 November 2026. The excerpts retain the text displayed by Google, including its English translations. The rating of 4.6 and 1,540 reviews refer to all reviews, not just this selection. Each card opens Google Maps reviews; there is no automatic synchronisation. Visit Google for all ratings, dates and full reviews.

Privacy and contact

The booking form is in demo mode: it does not send or store the details entered and does not make reservations. It includes no analytics or advertising. Actual bookings must be confirmed directly with the restaurant. Google links open an external service with its own terms. Fonts are loaded from Google Fonts; the hosting provider may process technical logs needed to serve the website.

Restaurant contact: 951 43 88 45.
